QuestInfo.name: A Night of Lights
QuestInfo.0: #b#p701##k has an idea for the first night of winter.
QuestInfo.1: Defeat #r50 #o58#es#k and #r50 #o56#s#k, and collect #b30 #t4000055#s#k and #b20 #t4000053#s#k from them. Then bring them to #b#p702##k so he can build lanterns for one night.
QuestInfo.2: The Hollow glowed with lanterns for one night. By morning, the spores had faded, as they always do.

0.0: Oh, it's you! The stores are full, so let's light up #b#m010006000##k for the first night of winter! Just for one night.
0.1: I need 30 #b#t4000055#s#k from #r#o58#es#k to lash the frames, and 20 #b#t4000053#s#k from #r#o56#s#k for the shades. Defeat #r50#k of each while you're at it, so the paths stay clear.
0.2: Bring them to #b#p702##k. He fills every lamp in #m010006000#, so nobody knows lanterns better.

yes.0: Yay! Take everything straight to #b#p702##k. He has the spores, too!

no.0: Aww. Winter's not here yet, I guess. But don't take too long!

1.0: #b#p701##k said you'd come. Lanterns for one night? That's a lot of work for one night, but fine.
1.1: Lashings, shades, and a pinch of my spores... Hold this steady. No, steadier.
1.2: There. They'll glow all night. By morning the spores will fade, as they always do.
1.3: Still, you've been a big help, human. Not bad for one night's work!
1.4: Now, take something from the Hollow's stores. You've earned it.

npc.0: Did you bring everything to #b#p702##k yet? He's in #b#m010006000##k... probably filling lamps again.

item.0: No materials, no lanterns. #b#p701##k said we'd need 30 #b#t4000055#s#k and 20 #b#t4000053#s#k.

mob.0: Not yet. The #r#o58#es#k and #r#o56#s#k are still all over the paths. Defeat #r50#k of each first, all right?
